snippet.title: Formlabs finally made a cheaper printer
snippet.description:
Thanks to Formlabs for providing the Form Studio 1 for this project.

More info: https://formlabs.com/3d-printers/form-studio-1/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=jeffgeerling-fs1-2026-07-26-global

(Note: The above link is a campaign tracking link, NOT an affiliate link. I do not participate in any manufacturer affiliate programs, only Amazon Affiliates, as part of my YouTube sponsorship policy.)

Other things I mentioned in this video:

  - GutBomb's MacPicoModem: https://jcm-1.com/product/macpicomodem/
  - T-Rex model: https://www.printables.com/model/428782-t-rex-skull
  - Apple ADB Mouse Shell: https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:4545460/comments
  - Formtest model: https://formlabs.com/blog/measuring-3d-printer-reliability-formtest/

Support me on Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/geerlingguy
Sponsor me on GitHub: https://github.com/sponsors/geerlingguy

2nd Channel: https://www.youtube.com/@GeerlingEngineering
3rd Channel: https://www.youtube.com/@Level2Jeff

00:00 - Formlabs Form Studio 1
